Need to know

FAQ

How do I place an order?

Add products to your bag, then tap “Order via WhatsApp”. Your selected items and total are prepared in a WhatsApp message so you can confirm the order directly with us.

Do I pay on the website?

No. This version is designed around WhatsApp confirmation. Payment and delivery details can be finalized in chat.

Can I ask about a product before ordering?

Absolutely. Use the WhatsApp button and send the product name. We can confirm availability, details and delivery information.
